test_title: PYST 47 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has two blanks. Choose the most suitable set of prepositions from the given options to fill in the blanks and complete the sentence meaningfully:

The politician distanced himself __________ the scandal and shifted blame __________ his aides.
solution:
The correct answer is '2', i.e., 'from, onto'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition **"from"** is used to indicate separation or distancing from something.
 
• The preposition **"onto"** is used to show movement or blame being shifted onto someone or something.
 
• In the given sentence, the politician distanced himself **from** the scandal and shifted blame onto</
